section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Control and ownership for AML compliance

propositions.proposition: 审查所有权结构时，有监管义务识别客户的最终受益所有人（UBO）。
source_quotes: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.

evidence_spans.quote: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.

propositions.proposition: 多数司法管辖区要求持股25%或以上认定为UBO；个人D合计持股82%被认定为UBO，个人C合计持股18%未被认定为UBO。
source_quotes: identified at a threshold of 25% or more

trigger_or_context: 需要判断持股是否达到适用阈值
basis_or_condition: 受益所有权识别阈值（25%或以上）
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 根据持股与阈值判断是否认定为UBO

evidence_spans.quote: identified at a threshold of 25% or more

propositions.proposition: 机构应采用风险为本的方法设定受益所有权阈值。
source_quotes: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.

trigger_or_context: 机构需要设定受益所有权阈值

evidence_spans.quote: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.

propositions.proposition: 对于高风险客户，受益所有权阈值可能低至10%甚至5%；例如，高风险司法管辖区的代理行关系可能设定5%的阈值。
source_quotes: might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5%

trigger_or_context: 客户为高风险或显著更高风险
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 受益所有权阈值可降低至10%或5%
outcomes_or_paths: 例如：高风险代理行关系可设定5%阈值

evidence_spans.quote: might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5%

propositions.proposition: 为了识别UBO，除了直接持股外，还需要识别间接持股。
source_quotes: In order to identify the UBOs of Company A, you need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership.

evidence_spans.quote: In order to identify the UBOs of Company A, you need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership.

propositions.proposition: 当公司没有自然人受益所有人时，应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人；例如，上市公司可将总裁或CEO作为名义受益所有人。
source_quotes: where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified.
a notional beneficial owner could be the president or chief executive officer

trigger_or_context: 公司没有自然人受益所有人
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人
outcomes_or_paths: 例如：上市公司可指定总裁或CEO为名义受益所有人

evidence_spans.quote: where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified.
a notional beneficial owner could be the president or chief executive officer
